component.name: Fancy Mumble
component.summary: Talk, chat and share your screen on a Mumble server

description.p: Fancy Mumble is a desktop client for Mumble, the low-latency voice chat protocol. It speaks the standard Mumble protocol, so it connects to any existing server, and adds a modern interface on top of it.

ul.li: Low-latency Opus voice with noise suppression, automatic gain control and a noise gate
Push-to-talk, voice activity detection, and per-channel listening
Rich text chat with Markdown, inline images, a GIF picker and polls
Screen and window sharing through the desktop portal, with hardware video encoding
Profile customisation: avatar frames, banners, nameplates and a bio editor
TLS throughout, support for self-signed server certificates, and no telemetry

description.p: End-to-end encrypted private chat is available as a separate add-on, because the Signal Protocol library it builds on is licensed under the AGPL. Install com.fancy_mumble.FancyMumble.SignalBridge to enable it.
